title: Ripples reflect a spectrum of synchronous spiking activity in human anterior temporal lobe (Tong et al., 2021): figure-level iEEG, micro-LFP and spiking arrays (derivative)
description: This derivative dataset repackages figure-level arrays from Tong et al. (2021), which studied ripples in the human anterior temporal lobe of patients with drug-resistant epilepsy. It contains iEEG, micro-LFP and sorted single-unit spiking data from 96-channel Utah microelectrode arrays, recorded during a paired-associates verbal memory task. The arrays include ripple-band signals, time-frequency power, ripple rasters, spike indices and pairwise phase consistency, and they reproduce panels of Figures 1-4 of the article. Raw continuous recordings are not included.
methods_description: Participants with epilepsy implanted with subdural/depth contacts and Utah microelectrode arrays at the NIH Clinical Center performed a paired-associates verbal episodic memory task. iEEG was sampled at 1000 Hz, with line-noise removal and Morlet wavelet power. Single units were obtained by threshold crossing and manual spike sorting. Ripples were detected in the 80-120 Hz band using a Hilbert envelope threshold (>2 SD for at least 25 ms, peak >3 SD).
